purpose: make the Global Experience Agent loop bounded, observable, recoverable, and deployable without importing external agent frameworks or hosted model dependencies

control_plane.relationship_to_c01_c05: C01 memory, C02 intent, C03 document parsing, C04 chunking retrieval, and C05 rerank calibration form the data plane; C06 Agent Loop is the control plane that decides the next bounded operation, observes results, and settles save points.

loop_contract.one_step_rule: each Continue/Run operation executes or routes at most one registered bounded operation before settlement; additional work becomes nextTurn, FollowUp, or a new authorized Continue call
loop_contract.owner_rule: the loop may request specialist work, but owner tool gates remain the only place where gated side effects execute

max_iterations.hard_rule: never use while-true execution for autonomous agent progress; every bounded loop declares an iteration ceiling
max_iterations.overflow_behavior: return partial evidence, current save point, and next authority boundary instead of silently continuing

error_recovery.rule: tool or parser failures become explicit Observation/ErrorFeedback records, never empty strings or hidden crashes
error_recovery.retry_rule: retry only read-only or owner-proven idempotent operations; non-idempotent tool calls are marked interrupted until an owner proves retry safety

transport_recovery.rule: when a known transport failure occurs before a completion marker, stop automatic retry, persist the durable boundary, and return a typed restart-required prompt
transport_recovery.resume_rule: after the user restarts Codex or the affected host, Resume from the durable session before Continue
transport_recovery.false_positive_rule: ordinary validation, parser, authorization, and business errors continue through the normal error path

host_watchdog.rule: after a Codex app thread snapshot, a long-running inProgress turn with no assistant/tool marker, or with a stale inProgress tool marker, becomes host-stall-suspected and returns a restart-required prompt
host_watchdog.action: persist a durable host-recovery marker and prompt; never force-kill
host_watchdog.resume_rule: after restart, Resume from the durable marker before Continue
host_watchdog.false_positive_rule: recent active turns, completed turns, completed tool markers, and insufficient snapshots remain non-stalled

context_budget.rule: preserve system/project authority, active task contract, latest save point, and recent bounded observations; summarize or retrieve older context through Agent memory or Codebase Memory instead of carrying raw transcripts
context_budget.no_regression: context economy must not skip authority, privacy, rollback, source verification, or validation gates

termination.triple_fallback_rule: a final response must not depend on a single marker; accept finish action, explicit final-answer signal, or hard iteration/authority boundary as stop evidence
termination.failure_behavior: if termination is reached without complete proof, emit a typed partial or blocked exit with residual risk

harness_requirements.system_prompt_contract: agent-facing instructions must include allowed operations, output/exit format, tool-gate boundaries, refusal/uncertainty behavior, and finish conditions
harness_requirements.tool_schema_contract: registered tools expose owner, parameters, side-effect class, idempotency, retry safety, and verification expectations
harness_requirements.error_handler: normalize timeout, rate limit, parameter, authorization, and unknown-tool failures into explicit observations or error-feedback reports

requires_owner_gate: OpenAI API or hosted model loop execution
authority_boundary.privacy_rule: loop traces in Git contain only safe metadata, path evidence, hashes, statuses, and typed exits; raw prompts, credentials, private transcripts, headers, and tool payloads remain unsafe by default
authority_boundary.source_verification_rule: episode 06 informs the control-plane contract; current local runtime, manifests, and tests remain final proof
